description: Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 Order under Section 25A Degree Awarding Institute Order
reasoning: This gazette content involves the issuance of a legal order under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, recognizing "Sri Lanka Institute of Textile and Apparel" as a Degree Awarding Institute. It establishes regulatory conditions and requirements for degree programs, making it primarily about legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
